title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-lee
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - Lee

Context:
- Quick personal notes for the console/observability triage session. Mostly messy, will consolidate into a post-mortem if anything escalates.
- Recent customer report (ACME Corp) about "slow dashboard loads" and missing traces around 2026-03-02 14:10 PST.
- Dashboard alert flapping on 'route:/generate - p50 latency' since 2026-03-01.

Top of queue (priorities)
1) ACME customer report - missing traces + slow dashboard (HIGH)
   - Customer notes: "Dashboard blank for 20s, then partial tiles. Traces show some requests with 5xx and others timed out."
   - First pass: looked at infra logs around 2026-03-02 14:00-14:30. Saw elevated error rate on backend service 'console-collector' and timeouts when calling /api/metrics.
   - Quick checks done: verified collector pods restarted ~14:05 (k8s restart events), memory OOM not obvious in pod logs.
   - Action items:
     - [ ] Grab full pod logs for console-collector from 13:50-14:30 and attach to JIRA INF-2345.
     - [ ] Check SLI dashboards for scrape latency and ingestion backlog around that time (metrics: collector.scrape.latency, collector.queue.backlog).
     - [ ] Ask infra SRE if any node reboots or network kicks in us-west-2 at ~14:00. (Slack pinged: @infra-sre)
     - [ ] Follow up with ACME support contact (Elena) with preliminary findings and ETA for root cause.

2) p50 latency alert flapping for /generate route (MED)
   - Symptoms: alert fires every ~10-30m, resolves after 3-5m. No clear gradual trend. Correlates with bursts of high token concurrency.
   - Hypothesis: batching/backpressure heuristics kick in under bursty traffic causing some requests to wait and push p50 up. Also possible kv-cache eviction thrashing for certain long-context requests.
   - Quick notes: model variants in serving logs show increased fallback to cpu-quantized models around alert windows.
   - Action items:
     - [ ] Collect a sample of request traces (trace ids) during alert windows and check batching sizes & queue depths.
     - [ ] Check routing logs to confirm whether traffic routed to lower-capacity dedicated nodes during bursts.
     - [ ] Add a short-term tweak: increase batch_max_wait_ms by 5ms for the next canary (dev only) to see effect. Create PR if useful.

3) Dashboard tile rendering bug: "Empty heatmap tile on Latency Overview" (LOW)
   - Repro: A few teams reported empty tile (no datapoints) after switching to 60s resolution. Happens when underlying series are aggregated and all points are NaN for the window.
   - Likely cause: frontend assumes at least one non-null point; backend now returns NaNs when aggregation window has gaps.
   - Action items:
     - [ ] Quick frontend patch to treat NaN-only series as zeros or show explanatory tooltip (UX) - file GH issue.
     - [ ] Backend: add optional flag to replace NaNs with last-known or 0 for UI routes. Evaluate perf impact.

Notes / debugging breadcrumbs:
- Found trace: trace_id=01e3a... (partial) showing collector->ingester RPC with deadline exceeded at 14:07. Saved locally to /tmp/lee-trace-20260302.log.
- Observed spike in collector.queue.depth metric (+120%) at 14:03; concordant with k8s HPA scaling up pods around 14:06. Might be transient spike due to upstream burst.
- GitHub PR 412 touches dashboard rendering and may have a regression in handling NaN series - flagged Samira to review.

Pending questions / TODOs to bring to tomorrow standup:
- Does infra SRE see any network packet drops or node events in us-west-2 at ~14:00? (I pinged but no reply yet.)
- If collector is the source, do we need to increase concurrency or tune backpressure at the gateway to smooth bursts?
- Can we add a short-lived 'ingest-backlog' alert that triggers earlier (queue depth > 100) to avoid customer-visible gaps?

Follow-ups (who owns)
- INF-2345 (Lee) - attach logs + initial customer reply (today EOD)
- Batch/route investigation (Jordan) - check traces and batching heuristics (due: 2026-03-04)
- Frontend fix for NaN tile (Samira) - temporary UX tweak (PR target: 2026-03-05)
- Infra SRE (owned by @infra-sre) - confirm node/network events and advise on mitigation

Scratch quick commands / queries used:
- kubectl --context prod get events --namespace console | grep 2026-03-02
- kubectl logs -l app=console-collector --since=45m --namespace console > /tmp/collector-logs-0302.log
- grafana query: sum by (pod) (rate(collector_scrape_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum by(pod) (rate(collector_scrape_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
- jaeger: trace 01e3a... -> jump to span 'collector.ingest' and export JSON

Quick notes to self:
- Keep notes light here; convert to formal incident once we confirm RCA (if customer-facing).
- If pattern repeats, propose adding a canary for collector scaling during peak windows.

End of scratchpad.
summary: Personal triage scratchpad capturing ACME customer report (missing traces, slow dashboard), p50 flapping on /generate, frontend NaN tile bug, and action items assigned to Lee, Jordan, Samira, infra-sre.
